units.source_text: 这句话，我听起来很不自然，甚至错以为她在说“要把我怎么样”呢。

en.t: Those words sounded very unnatural to me, and I even mistakenly thought she was saying, "What are you going to do to me?"

units.source_text: 真是的，我要把这个没有成年的十六岁姑娘怎么样呢？

en.t: Good heavens, what was I going to do with this sixteen-year-old girl who was not yet of age?
I had fallen into a world of fantasy.

units.source_text: 此时此刻，我不是在空想的世界里，让作为活人的道子同没有血液的玩偶道子都舞蹈起来了吗？

en.t: At that very moment, was I not making both the living Michiko and the bloodless doll Michiko dance in my world of fantasy?
Could this be what love is?

units.source_text: 美其名曰婚姻，不就是等于杀掉一个女子来活跃我的遐思吗？

en.t: Even if it is given the fine name of marriage, is it not the same as killing a woman in order to enliven my own idle fancies?

units.source_text: “怎么样啦”这句话，听起来恍如摔破了东西，令人感到悲伤。

en.t: The words "What happened?" sounded as though something had been smashed, and they made me feel sad.

units.source_text: 把纯真、刚强、闪闪发光的道子，当作朦胧、没有分量的东西，

en.t: To treat the innocent, strong, shining Michiko as something hazy and weightless,

units.source_text: 让它轻盈地飞向自由的蓝天，这无论是不是恋爱，是不是婚姻，都是我要祷告的。

en.t: and let her fly lightly into the free blue sky, whether or not that is love, whether or not it is marriage, is what I want to pray for.
